Hi Alex / Marissa —

Thanks for looping procurement in. A few notes from our side: 

1) Acme policy: no vendor onboarding without a signed PO for any subscription or SaaS spend that will be active beyond 30 days or exceeds $5,000. We do not allow corporate card for multi-month SaaS contracts unless preapproved by Finance (rare).
2) Prepay: Finance will not accept third-party prepay models for SaaS without a business case and exec signoff.
3) Marketplace: AWS Marketplace is preferred — it simplifies invoicing and costs are billed to our AWS account. If Redwood is on AWS Marketplace, it will expedite procurement.

If Redwood requires card-only payment or third-party prepay as a contractual requirement, we'll need an exemption request with legal & finance signoff. Please advise next steps if you need an exception.

Procurement Team
Acme Corp
Attachment: Acme_PO_Policy.pdf

Hi Procurement Team / Alex —

Thanks for the clarity and for sharing Acme's policy. We can accommodate the PO route and are listed on AWS Marketplace but there are a few edge cases I want to make sure we surface now so we don't slow the pilot: 

- Exception request: Redwood's standard self-serve hosted product supports card and marketplace billing. We can accept a PO and invoice monthly, but Redwoods' enterprise sales process may require a short lead time to provision invoices and billing setup (usually 3–5 business days after countersign).
- Prepay model: Redwood does offer prepay/commit options for Dedicated/reserved capacity; these require a contract addendum and Finance approval on our side.
- No-PO customers: If Acme cannot issue a PO for the pilot and insists on card-only, we can support card payments for pilots under $5k, but we need written approval from the cardholder and confirmation that the product will not auto-renew into a subscription beyond the pilot without a PO.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Alex — confirm whether you'll try to get procurement signoff for a card exception for the pilot (<= $5k) or start the PO workflow.
2) Procurement Team — if you require an exemption request for prepay or cardless onboarding, please reply with the required approvals and contacts (Legal/Finance) so we can prepare a short exception package.
3) Ben and Neha from Redwood — can you prepare a one-page exception packet outlining the pilot scope, estimated spend, and proposed controls (no auto-renew, spend cap $X, cancellation terms)? I’ll attach it to the exception request to speed approvals.

We’ll also attach the signed quote and a DocuSign envelope if you prefer countersignature.

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call (15m) to walk procurement through the pilot details.

Best,
